data.title: KSrelief Distributes 306 Food Baskets to Earthquake Victims on Indonesia's Flores Island
data.content:
Jakarta, November 20, 2026, SPA -- The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) distributed 306 food baskets on Wednesday to earthquake victims in Manggarai Regency on Flores Island, Republic of Indonesia, benefiting 1,224 people.
    The distribution is part of a project to provide relief to earthquake victims in Indonesia and is part of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia's ongoing efforts through KSrelief to support people affected by crises.
    -- SPA
20:57 Local Time 17:57 GMT
